description: Six linear voltage-controlled amplifiers that also work as a six-into-one mixer, each channel's level set by a knob and a CV input

params.text: Sets that channel's gain, from silence at fully counter-clockwise to unchanged at fully clockwise; the CV input multiplies this setting rather than replacing it

inputs.text: The signal that channel amplifies; leave it unpatched and the channel takes whatever reached the input above it
Multiplies that channel's LEVEL knob; it is clamped to 0V-5V and the channel is fully open at 5V, and with nothing patched it reads 5V so the knob works on its own

outputs.text: That channel's input at the gain its knob and CV set
Channels 1 to 6 added together at their own gains and soft-clipped at ±10V, and also channel 6's own output

notes: a channel drops out of the mix as soon as its own output jack is patched, which turns it from a mixer input into a separate VCA. Channel 6 stays in, since its jack is the mix output.
the six inputs cascade: a channel with nothing patched reads the channel above it, and channel 1 with nothing patched reads 0V. Patch one input and every channel below it follows.
menu: Clip Output ±10V — soft-clips the mix output at ±10V; on by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
